name: Partyline
overview: A Syncplay Chat fork adding private WebRTC voice to Jellyfin SyncPlay.
description: Keeps the original SyncPlay text chat and adds opt-in WebRTC mesh voice with authenticated signaling, adaptive audio, and optional coturn fallback.

versions.changelog: Partyline is an independently maintained fork of Syncplay Chat by Abhay V Ashokan. It preserves the original SyncPlay text chat and adds opt-in peer-to-peer WebRTC voice, persistent chat history, mobile and playback-aware controls, and reconnect recovery. Caddy provides HTTPS for microphone access; optional coturn settings remain available only when direct WebRTC connections fail. See NOTICE.md for attribution and docs/caddy-https.md for private-network setup.
